convert_densepose_to_bitmasks: convert DensePose predictor outputs to BitMasks using ToMaskConverter.convert with boxes and image size
register_mask_converter: register a custom converter for a DensePose output type using ToMaskConverter.register as a decorator
lookup_mask_converter: look up a registered mask converter for a given DensePose output type via the registry
